title: 3377. Digit Operations to Make Two Integers Equal

examples.explanation: We perform the following operations: Increase the first digit, now n = 20. Increase the second digit, now n = 21. Increase the second digit, now n = 22. Decrease the first digit, now n = 12.
It is impossible to make n equal to m.
Since 2 is already a prime, we can't make n equal to m.
